Card Q&A.q: This card is being deleted. Can I use this card's effect to place it at the bottom of 1 of my green Digimon's digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, you can.The [On Deletion] effect is activated while treated as [Sukamon], but the name changing effect is lost when the card is deleted and placed in the trash, so you can treat this card as a [Palmon] card.

Card Q&A.q: This card that was targeted by [BT11-043 KingSukamon]'s effect and had its name changed to [Sukamon] is deleted. If I have no other [Palmon] in the trash, can I place this same card at the bottom of the digivolution cards of one of my green Digimon from the trash with it's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] Place 1 [Palmon] from your trash under 1 of your green Digimon at the bottom of its digivolution cards.
